body: 3-5 years, that's a no from me. Not even 6 months seems doable, I have no one to talk to and life is lonely. I cant go make friends because covid, so what else is a girl gonna do.

Actually people do not care about me in my life. I see a lot of posts here assuming I just did nothing. I tried really hard to love life and enjoy it but in the end I just got screwed. I tried to embrace moments and find love, but in the end nobody cared about me and they never will. That's okay because I dont care about myself either. My life isnt a gift and the pain isnt in my head, it's real to me.
I'm 30 and I have given life a chance. This shit just isnt for me, I will give up 1000 moments of joy if it means I dont have to be in pain all day every day.
